title: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
summary: Rich, dense chocolate brownies with a crackly top and a soft, fudgy centre. Best served warm with coffee, ice cream, or on their own as an easy dessert.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and line a 20 cm square baking tin with baking paper.
Melt the dark chocolate and butter together gently in a heatproof bowl over a pan of barely simmering water, then stir until smooth. Leave to cool for a few minutes.
Whisk the sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract together in a large bowl until pale and slightly thickened.
Pour in the melted chocolate mixture and stir until fully combined.
Sift in the plain flour, cocoa powder, and salt, then fold gently until no dry streaks remain. Stir in the chocolate chunks.
Scrape the batter into the prepared tin and smooth the top.
Bake for 22 to 25 minutes, until the top looks set and crackly but the centre still has a slight wobble.
Cool completely in the tin before lifting out and slicing into squares.
